title: Getaway to Vietnam | Group Tour Package
highlights: Experience the thrill of shooting an AK-47 at the renowned Cu Chi Tunnels shooting range, where you’ll get a hands-on opportunity to test your marksmanship.
Discover the diverse beauty of Vietnam, from the historic streets of Hanoi to the coastal charm of Da Nang, and the bustling energy of Ho Chi Minh City.
Capture the unique charm of Hanoi Train Street, where trains pass through narrow residential alleys, offering a stunning glimpse into daily life.
Experience the vibrant blend of culture, entertainment, and shopping at Mega Grand World, a destination that showcases the heart of the city's modern allure.
Explore Saigon’s bustling shopping scene with vibrant markets, trendy boutiques, and lively street vendors offering diverse goods and local treasures.

know_before_you_go: All visitors need to carry a valid ID proof.
Visa assistance will be provided however charges are not included.
Please do not litter and keep the destination clean.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

One can apply for E-Visa online or can get an on arrival Visa stamped while completing the immigration process at the airport. The tourist visa for Indian Tourist is valid for 30 days and can cost an approx of INR 3000/- to 4500/-.
Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience.
Travel Insurance is recommended and charges are not included.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Hanoi City Tour with Mega Grand World and Hanoi Train Street
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival, you’ll be driven to your hotel. Check in & take some time to relax. Later, get driven for a city tour & visit the Temple of Literature, Vietnam's historic center of learning. Next, explore the Hoa Lo Prison Museum, and experience the unique charm of Hanoi Train Street, where trains pass through a lively neighborhood. Also, visit Mega Grand World, where modern shopping & dining come together. Afterwards, you’ll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Full Day Halong Bay Cruise
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Tuan Chau harbor and board your Halong Bay cruise. Enjoy a delicious lunch onboard and cruise past stunning limestone formations like Incense Burner and Cock Fighting rocks. Next, explore the impressive Amazing Cave, glide through the serene waters of Luon Cave via kayak or bamboo boat, and visit Ti Top Island for beach activities or a scenic trek to Titov Peak. Later, cruise back to the Tuan Chau harbor and get driven back to your hotel in Hanoi.

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh with Lunch | Flight to Da Nang
days.desc: In the morning, check-out and get transferred to Hoa Lu in Ninh Binh district. There, explore the ancient temples of the Le and Dinh Dynasties, steeped in rich history. Afterward, enjoy a delicious lunch followed by a leisurely boat trip through Tam Coc. Glide through limestone caves & conclude your day with a transfer to the airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to your hotel. Check-in & rest for the night.

days.title: Day Trip to Marble Mountains, Coconut Forest and Son Tra Peninsula | Hoi An Evening tour with Dinner
days.desc: Today, get driven to Son Tra Peninsula. There, marvel at the Linh Ung Pagoda's 67-meter statue. Next, explore Marble Mountains, Am Phu Cave, and admire stone art at Non-Nuoc Village. Then, enjoy Cam Thanh Coconut Forest with basket boat rowing and fishing. Next, get transferred to Hoi An & visit ancient sites like the Japanese Bridge and Phuc Kien Pagoda, shop at the Central Market, and explore the night market. Afterwards, savor a delightful dinner & get driven back to your hotel in Da Nang.

days.title: Ba Na Hill Full Day Tour | Flight to Ho Chi Minh
days.desc: Today, post check out, you will get driven to Suoi Mo Cable Car Station & hop on a cable car ride to Ba Na Hills . Upon arrival, explore the Golden Bridge, renowned as The Hands of The Gods. Next, visit Le Jardin D’Amour and continue to Linh Ung Pagoda & Debay Wine Cellar. Enjoy lunch & use your free time to explore Fantasy Park. Afterwards, get driven to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh. Upon arrival, get transferred to your hotel. Check-in & rest for the night.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour | Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels & Shooting Experience from AK 47 | Shopping Tour in Ho Chi Minh
days.desc: Today, get driven for a city tour visiting the Independence Palace, built on the former Norodom Palace grounds. You can also visit to Notre Dame Cathedral & other attractions. Later, get driven to visit Cu Chi tunnels. Upon arrival, explore the tunnel systems, and experience the thrill of shooting a AK-47 (5 bullets per person). Return to Ho Chi Mingh for shopping. There you can shop at Saigon Square & Ben Thanh Market. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
